lxc_8aa8999aa372ce36.text: Football is a game between two teams.

lxc_b511b308ba3b63b3.text: One of those players is the goalkeeper.

lxc_076664231308d36a.text: The goalkeeper can use their hands inside their own goal area.

lxc_872e7643188eb796.text: The other players can only use their feet, legs, and head — not their hands.

lxc_bab1e2729c9130dd.text: The goal of the game is simple: kick the ball into the other team's net.

lxc_fc2272efb9fc5218.text: Each time the ball goes into the net, that team scores one goal.

lxc_1b212fedfef2e3b1.text: At the end of the game, the team with the most goals wins.

lxc_6346d9e87146df80.text: A standard football match has two halves.

lxc_51460bd8f17cb22f.text: So a full match is 90 minutes in total.

lxc_10034cbb7e47491c.text: At the end of 90 minutes, if the score is equal — for example, 1–1 — the match is a draw.

lxc_c5514595047f2a8c.text: In some games, like a knockout match, a draw is not allowed.

lxc_3480934d213dbcda.text: Then the teams play extra time: two more periods of 15 minutes each.

lxc_2fa69f1331e733d0.text: If the score is still equal after extra time, the game is decided by a penalty shootout.

lxc_d54478d129494b6a.text: In a penalty shootout, players take turns shooting at the goal from close range.

lxc_053092eb47b17988.text: There will be 104 matches in total — more than any World Cup before.
